summary: Ported the preserved private immutable editorial contact-sheet projection and its owner-checked route into the current editorial contract. A manifest is emitted only for a completed shoot with exactly six approved canonical slots and hash-bound PNG outputs; it is deterministic and excludes private resource, execution, runtime, prompt, and provider metadata.

pre_change_proof.evidence: The preserved contact-sheet regression test was applied to the exact task base; the exact acceptance command failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND because the contact-sheet module did not exist before this change.

post_change_proof.evidence: The exact focused acceptance command passed 21 of 21 tests, including deterministic canonical ordering, completed-and-approved gating, private no-store routing, and rejection before a foreign profile triggers a service lookup.
Whitespace and conflict-marker validation passed from the exact task base through the exact tested code SHA.

adversarial_review.goal: Find a fail-open completed-state check, incomplete or duplicate frame acceptance, cross-profile lookup or disclosure, nondeterministic order or hash, leakage of private resource, runtime, prompt, or provider data, or any weakened quality check.

open_risks.description: The raw pre-change command transcript is local-only; the exact command, preserved regression test, base SHA, and deterministic failure reason are recorded so the acceptance runner can replay the proof.
